content:
tess: seeing apiserver 503s in asia-east at 11:03 UTC. controller-manager leader flips and etcd write stalls. anyone?

omar: checking etcd metrics - WAL fsync p95 ~300ms. iowait on etcd-primary is high.

lin: correlated with a large attach burst from provisioner. lots of short TCP connects -> conntrack high on edge proxies.

tess: chain hypothesis: attach retries -> SNAT/conntrack exhaustion -> control-plane request stalls -> etcd WAL latency spike -> apiserver 5xxs.

omar: mitigation applied: reduced provisioner attach concurrency from 40->6, paused rollout, bumped nf_conntrack on proxies.

lin: also moved etcd leader to node with lower IO (etcdctl move-leader). WAL fsync dropped to ~35ms and apiserver errors fell.

sre-bot: Incident INC-2026-2007 created. pager notified.

tess: follow-ups: add attach concurrency default lower, add pre-rollout SNAT capacity check, provisioner backoff + jitter. lin/omar to own tickets.

lin: opening GH-5801 (provisioner: attach backoff), GH-5802 (network: conntrack autoscale).

omar: cost note: some cross-region fallback traffic added ~$1.9k in egress during spike. filed billing ticket.

tess: leaving throttles in place; monitoring for 30m. mark P2 for now.
